data.title: Technical Product Owner (m/w/d)
data.description:
Your mission

You want to do more than just contribute ideas — you want to actively shape a software product from the first concept through to release? As Product Owner at Relution, you take responsibility for the continued development of our “Made in Germany” UEM and MDM platform.

You will work closely with customers, Engineering, UX, Sales and Management. You understand requirements, challenge assumptions and work with the team to turn real problems into meaningful product solutions.

  • You monitor the UEM and MDM market, analyse competitors and technology trends, and contribute insights to our product strategy and roadmap
  • You gather and evaluate requirements from customers across education, public sector, healthcare and enterprise, as well as from partners, Sales and Management
  • You prioritise topics based on customer value, strategic relevance and effort, and take ownership of the product backlog for your areas
  • You challenge requirements, identify the underlying problem and work with UX and Engineering to develop the right solution
  • You translate requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria and support implementation from concept through to release
  • You work closely with our development teams in a technically demanding environment covering Apple, Android Enterprise and Windows
  • You work on topics such as device management, enterprise app management, security, identity, APIs and platform integrations
  • You collect feedback on new functionality and continuously improve existing features
  • You represent Relution as a product expert in customer and partner discussions, at trade fairs, webinars and training sessions
  • For complex functional or technical topics, you support the wider team and ensure that relevant insights feed back into the product


Your Course

  • You have several years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or in a comparable role for a software product
  • You understand technical concepts, can discuss them with developers on an equal footing and are able to explain complex topics clearly and concisely
  • You combine technical understanding with a strong business mindset and want to take responsibility for a successful B2B software product
  • You are able to structure and prioritise requirements and are comfortable making clear decisions about what should — and should not — be built
  • Experience with Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), Mobile Device Management (MDM), Enterprise Mobility, IT security or comparable B2B software products is a strong advantage — but not a requirement
  • A degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering or a comparable field is beneficial — but your experience, product mindset and technical curiosity matter more to us
  • You communicate clearly, enjoy working across different teams and take ownership of your topics
  • Very good German and good English skills complete your profile


Your profile

  • You are given responsibility and the freedom to make your own decisions
  • We work closely together and value direct communication over lengthy coordination processes
  • We want you to challenge requirements rather than simply accept them and help us find the best solution for the product
  • We continuously improve our processes instead of simply maintaining them
  • You do not need to meet every requirement from day one — willingness to learn and technical curiosity matter just as much as experience


What´s important to us

  • The ability to work independently as part of a team that supports you rather than leaving you on your own
  • Open communication instead of lengthy coordination loops
  • A desire to question processes and improve them rather than just managing them
  • Apply even if you don’t meet all the criteria 100% – a willingness to learn counts just as much as experience to us


Why us?

  • Flexible working: Flexible working hours, transparent time tracking, part-time options and a hybrid working model with plenty of flexibility regarding where you work
  • 30 days of holiday + 6 flex days: Giving you enough time to recharge outside of work
  • A strong start: Mentoring from day one to help you quickly get up to speed with the product and the team
  • Macademy: Our own development programme for everyone who wants to grow professionally and personally
  • Stay mobile: We subsidise your Deutschlandticket
  • Get on your bike: (E-)bike leasing through JobRad, with our own bicycle storage and showers at the office
  • Plan ahead: Company pension scheme included
  • Well looked after: Subsidised lunch in our canteen and free drinks throughout the day
  • Stay active: Wellpass or Urban Sports Club — whichever suits you best
  • Team moments: Regular team events and activities
  • Our home in Stuttgart: Modern, bright offices with excellent public transport connections
We were recognised by FOCUS-Business as one of Germany’s Top Employers among medium-sized companies in 2026.

If you want to help shape a technically sophisticated software product and take real ownership of the future development of Relution, we look forward to hearing from you.

Team Lead Sales Development

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Wir suchen eine:n Team Lead Sales Development (SDR), um gemeinsam die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu erreichen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Sales und arbeitest eng mit unseren Commercial-Teams zusammen. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit, das die europäische Industrie wieder wettbewerbsfähiger macht – und setzt deine Ideen mit hohem Tempo um.

Die Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. trawa ist ein Office-First-Unternehmen: In der Regel arbeitest du an fünf Tagen pro Woche aus unserem Büro.

Das Team

Das trawa SDR-Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber des Unternehmens und einer unserer wichtigsten Kanäle zur Generierung neuer Kundenbeziehungen. Das derzeit sechsköpfige Team vereint vielseitige Erfahrungen im Vertrieb und schafft dadurch ein dynamisches Umfeld. Nach einer Phase starken Wachstums liegt der Fokus nun darauf, diesen Erfolg weiter auszubauen und gemeinsam den nächsten Wachstumsschritt zu gestalten.

Wen wir suchen

  • Als Player-Coach übernimmst du die Verantwortung für den Erfolg des SDR-Teams und bist gleichzeitig selbst operativ aktiv. Du verbringst den überwiegenden Teil deiner Zeit mit Cold Calling und gehst mit deiner eigenen Performance als gutes Beispiel voran.

  • Du verantwortest die Team-Performance ganzheitlich, steuerst die Zielerreichung und entwickelst das Team kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in Prozessen und Strukturen, bringst die Perspektive des Teams aktiv ein und setzt gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern im Unternehmen Verbesserungen um.

  • Du bist ein zentraler Bestandteil des Recruiting-Prozesses für neue SDRs und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team für ein strukturiertes und erfolgreiches Onboarding neuer Teammitglieder.

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du hast ein fundiertes Verständnis für unsere Produkte und den Energiemarkt aufgebaut.

  • Du hast dich als feste Ansprechperson für alle Themen rund um das SDR-Team etabliert.

  • Deine eigene Performance im Cold Calling setzt erste neue Maßstäbe.

  • Du hast erste Optimierungspotenziale zur Steigerung der Team-Performance identifiziert und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen abgeleitet.

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Überzeugungskraft und hohes Durchsetzungsvermögen zeichnen dich aus.

  • Du kommst leicht mit Menschen ins Gespräch, verstehst Bedürfnisse und stellst passende Lösungen überzeugend vor.

  • Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an.

  • Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken.

  • Du hast umfangreiche Erfahrungen rund um vertrieblichen Methoden und Techniken.

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Warum trawa?

Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung.

Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt.

Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können.

Vergütung und Benefits: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket mit Gehalt und Stock Options, 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zahlreichen Benefits. Dazu gehören Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents.

data.title: Accounts Receivable Accountant
data.description:
Accounts Receivable Accountant

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

Our Mission For You

Own the process that turns invoices into cash, and shape how trawa's Finance function scales with our customer base.

trawa enables mid-sized industrial and commercial companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're in a hyper-growth phase in one of the most complex markets in Germany. It's a rare moment to join: the foundations are being built right now, the problems are real, and the room to shape how Finance runs at scale is wide open.

This is one of the most critical roles in the company. Cash is what enables trawa's growth, and you own the process that protects it. Every reconciliation you close, every overdue account you resolve, every dispute you clean up feeds directly into how fast we can move.

As our Accounts Receivable Accountant, you'll own the end-to-end AR and collections process. You'll be the person customers talk to when something on an invoice isn't clear, and the person internally who makes sure open items don't stay open. You'll work closely with Customer Success, Business Operations, and our Finance team.

If you're excited by ownership, an AI-first way of working, and building something that actually matters, this is your role.


What You'll Own

Collections and Dunning

  • Own the collections cadence end-to-end: monitor AR aging, prioritise the highest-impact accounts, and drive them to resolution via email and phone.

  • Reduce DSO measurably. You set the pace, we give you the tools and the mandate.

  • Manage our dunning process reliably and with the right tone: firm on cash, respectful of the customer relationshipDebitorenbuchhaltung und operative Prozesse.

Reconciliation and Cash Application

  • Reconcile incoming payments against open invoices, investigate and resolve unapplied cash, short-pays, and discrepancies.

  • Run structured reconciliations reliably, and independently drive ad-hoc analyses for complex payments or edge cases.

  • Support month-end close with AR reconciliations and clean aging reports.

Ticket Ownership and Customer Interaction

  • Take ownership of our AR ticket queue, which is currently high-volume and one of the most visible pain points across the company. You get on top of it, categorise what's coming in, and resolve the majority of tickets directly.

  • Be the go-to Finance contact for customers on all relevant topics: invoicing, payments, and account requests.

  • Work closely with Customer Success and BizOps to resolve customer issues end-to-end and make sure Finance topics don't get stuck between teams.


Who You Are

Must-haves

  • 3+ years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Collections, or Credit Control, or a comparable Finance role. Ideally in a high-volume and complex B2B environment

  • Solid understanding of AR processes: dunning, cash application, reconciliations, and month-end AR work.

  • Confident with customers in writing and on the phone. You can be firm on cash without damaging the relationship.

  • Strong ownership mindset. You don't wait for someone to flag a problem. You spot it, dig into the root cause, and drive it to resolution across stakeholders.

  • Structured, analytical, and detail-oriented. You keep complex open items straight without losing the bigger picture.

  • Business fluent in English and solid written German (customer correspondence in German needs to work reliably). Spoken German is a strong plus but not required.

  • Comfortable in the standard office and analytics toolset (Excel or Google Sheets) and able to navigate independently.

Nice-to-haves

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a comparable field, or a solid vocational qualification (e.g. Bilanzbuchhalter:in IHK, Steuerfachangestellte:r, kaufmännische Ausbildung). We care about what you can do, not the badge on your CV.

  • Experience with AI-powered reconciliation tools or modern ticketing systems.

  • Genuine curiosity for AI and automation. Bonus if you've already used Langdock, Claude, or similar tools to speed up your own work.

  • Experience in a fast-growing start-up or scale-up environment.


Your First 90 Days

Month 1: Understand

  • Understand trawa's business model, customer base, and billing logic, including what makes energy billing genuinely complex

  • Map our AR process end-to-end (invoicing, collections, cash application, close) and get to know your key counterparts in Customer Success, BizOps, and Accounting

  • Take over recurring work: ticket triage, aging analysis, dunning follow-ups

Month 2: Take Ownership

  • Run the AR cycle largely independently: aging monitored proactively, customer follow-ups sent on time, accounts reconciled cleanly

  • Contribute to your first month-end close reliably and on time

  • Identify one concrete process gap in collections, reconciliation, or ticket handling, and come with a plan to fix it

Month 3: Build and Improve

  • You're the reliable Finance point of contact for customer-facing AR topics. The ticket backlog is under control and issues get resolved before they escalate

  • DSO is trending in the right direction and month-end contributions are delivered without follow-up

  • You've shipped at least one meaningful process improvement and can point to its impact

  • You're actively shaping how our AR processes scale as trawa's customer base grows


Why trawa?

  • Direct collaboration with Finance leadership and cross-functional leaders from day one. Short paths, real decisions, real ownership

  • A uniquely complex business at the intersection of energy, software, and B2B operations. You'll learn a lot, fast

  • An AI-first and automation-first Finance team. You'll set up scalable processes and drive them forward through process automation and larger tool implementations.

  • Real room to grow as trawa scales, your scope grows with the company.

  • Flexible working, 30 vacation days, L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, Urban Sports Club membership, and a vibrant office culture in Berlin

Diversity at trawa

Everyone is welcome here. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace that values diversity, and we encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, physical or neurodiverse background.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We value ownership, learning speed, and aren't hunger over a perfect CV.

  • You are fluent or a native German speaker (this is a mandatory requirement). You also have strong written and verbal English skills.

Working cross-functionally across hardware design, physical testing, and field operations, you will translate messy real-world data into actionable design changes and world-class reliability standards.

Your Responsibilities

  • Direct the multi-year reliability and endurance test roadmap, serving as the technical authority for the physical test team executing it.

  • Close the loop against field and service data, translating operational insights into optimized maintenance intervals, spare-part strategies, and concrete design changes.

  • Own system-level reliability across our core products and module families, building Reliability Block Diagrams (RBDs) to aggregate component data into module-, arm-, and system-level reliability targets at defined confidence levels.

  • Set reliability requirements early and rigorously enforce them during design reviews to actively shape and refine the product architecture.

  • Drive failure mode identification by leading DFMEA and FMEDA sessions at system and module levels, while spearheading root-cause analyses for real-world failures.

  • Execute deep statistical analyses, calculating MTBF/MTTF for random failures and L10/B10 wear-out life for bearings, gears, and brakes while defending underlying assumptions.

  • Evaluate data integrity with sharp engineering judgment, knowing precisely when data is decision-grade versus a placeholder to guide leadership decisions.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Completed vocational training or a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or comparable experience.

  • Several years of experience in reliability engineering focused on complex electro/mechanical products.

  • Strong ownership and growth mindset, pragmatic working style and analytical rigor to reach defensible conclusions from incomplete evidence.

  • Very good English skills (German is a plus).

data.title: Accounting Lead (m/f/d)
data.description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

In dieser Schlüsselrolle bist du eine tragende Säule unseres Finance-Teams und sorgst für finanzielle Präzision, Compliance und Skalierbarkeit. Dein Fokus liegt nicht nur auf der Aufrechterhaltung des Status quo, sondern darauf, eine hocheffiziente, automatisierte und moderne Buchhaltungslandschaft mitzugestalten, die mit unserem globalen Wachstum und unseren internationalen Standorten Schritt hält.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB und stellst die Überleitung zu IFRS und US-GAAP für unseren CFO und unsere Investoren sicher.

  • Du führst fachlich unser Accounting-Team (aktuell zwei Kolleginnen sowie ein externer Buchhaltungsdienstleister) und bist erste Anlaufstelle für buchhalterische Fragen im Tagesgeschäft.

  • Du verantwortest die Umsatzrealisierung unserer Anlagenbau-nahen Robotikprojekte, inklusive der sauberen Abgrenzung von Anzahlungen nach HGB sowie IFRS/US-GAAP.

  • Du planst und begleitest Inventuren, insbesondere die Bewertung unfertiger Erzeugnisse und aktivierter Eigenleistungen, und stellst eine belastbare Bestandsbewertung sicher.

  • Du überwachst die laufende Finanzbuchhaltung, von der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung über die Anlagenbuchhaltung bis zur Liquiditätsplanung,und springst bei Bedarf operativ mit ein.

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für Steuerberater und Wirtschaftsprüfer und verantwortest die Vorbereitung und Begleitung des jährlichen KPMG-Audits.

  • Du begleitest die Migration unseres ERP-Systems und den Aufbau der internen Buchhaltung, mit dem Ziel, die Prozesse 2027 vollständig inhouse abzubilden.

  • Du verantwortest das Intercompany-Management zwischen RobCo GmbH und unserer US-Tochtergesellschaft, stellst eine einheitliche Bilanzierung über beide Standorte sicher und koordinierst die Buchhaltung mit unserer US-Tochter.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Controlling, Personalabteilung, Supply Chain/Operations und Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Dein Profil

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und triffst Entscheidungen auch dort, wo Prozesse noch nicht bis ins Detail definiert sind, statt auf explizite Vorgaben zu warten.

  • Du bringst Belastbarkeit und Gelassenheit für eine wachstumsbedingt unruhige und sich wandelnde Organisation mit.

  • Du kommunizierst offen und direkt, auch bei Fehlern oder Rückfragen, und passt damit zum direkten, unternehmerischen Arbeitsstil unseres CFO und der Geschäftsführung.

  • Du benennst fachliche Wissensgrenzen offen und findest eigenständig eine Lösung, anstatt bei kritischen Rückfragen auszuweichen.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher (mindestens C1).

  • Du kannst komplexe bilanzielle Sachverhalte, etwa die Systematik der HGB-Bilanzierung, auch mündlich verständlich gegenüber unserem englischsprachigen CFO und unseren Investoren erklären.

  • Abgeschlossene Weiterbildung zum geprüften Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) mit mehrjähriger, nachweisbarer praktischer Berufserfahrung, keine reine Kurs- oder Theoriequalifikation.

  • Abschlusssicherheit in den Hauptbüchern nach HGB sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in IFRS und US-GAAP, inklusive der Fähigkeit, Überleitungsrechnungen zwischen HGB- und US-Sicht selbstständig zu erstellen.

  • Du verantwortest die Umsatzrealisierung unserer Anlagenbau-nahen Robotikprojekte, inklusive der sauberen Abgrenzung von Anzahlungen nach HGB sowie IFRS/US-GAAP.

  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung und Steuerung von Inventuren (Stichtags- und permanente Inventur) sowie in der Bestandsbewertung, idealerweise inklusive unfertiger Erzeugnisse.

  • Operative und praktische, nicht nur überwachende Erfahrung in der Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung, du kannst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mitbuchen, wenn es die Situation erfordert.

  • Erfahrung im Intercompany-Accounting und in der Zusammenarbeit mit US-Tochtergesellschaften von Vorteil.

  • Erfahrung mit gängiger Buchhaltungssoftware bzw. ERP (z. B. DATEV, Odoo, Moss, Ramp) sowie Offenheit für die Begleitung eines ERP-Systemwechsels.

  • Erfahrung in einem produzierenden, technologiegetriebenen oder wachstumsstarken Unternehmen ist von Vorteil.

Warum RobCo?

  • Entwickle mit uns modulare, softwaredefinierte Robotiklösungen, die neue Maßstäbe in der Automatisierung setzen.

  • Hilf uns dabei, Roboter zu bauen, die mit modernster KI ausgestattet sind, ihre Umgebung wahrnehmen, Daten analysieren und in Echtzeit intelligente Entscheidungen treffen.

  • Als Teil eines sehr dynamischen und schnell wachsenden Scale-ups übernimmst du vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung, treibst deine eigenen Projekte voran und siehst den direkten Einfluss deiner Arbeit.

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. The Role

As our first Senior Partner Marketing Manager, you will build the partner marketing function from scratch - co-defining the strategy with our VP of Marketing and owning the execution end-to-end. This is not a role where you hand off to someone else to implement. You design it, you build it, and you run it. If you need someone else to execute for you, this is not the right role. Partner Marketing Strategy

  • Define a differentiated marketing approach per partner tier - Tier 1 partners receive a full co-marketing program; Tier 2 and Tier 3 partners receive scaled, asset-led support

  • Translate the overall partner strategy into a concrete, executable marketing plan with clear milestones and KPIs

Partner Marketing Infrastructure & Tracking

  • Build the infrastructure for partner marketing from the ground up: processes, templates, tracking mechanisms, and reporting frameworks

  • Own the tracking of all partner marketing activities and their contribution to pipeline and revenue

  • Develop and maintain a clear view of partner marketing performance across the ecosystem

Partner Marketing Guidelines, Content & Assets

  • Develop partner marketing guidelines that ensure consistent positioning and messaging in line with RobCo's category leadership in Autonomous Industrial Robotics

  • Create and manage co-marketing assets, content, and campaigns in close collaboration with partners - in both German and English depending on the partner

  • Equip partners with the materials they need to go to market effectively on RobCo's behalf

  • Own the marketing relationship with partners across all tiers - from large international system integrators to smaller traditional German industrial firms

  • Build strong working relationships directly with partner contacts, including partners who work exclusively in German

  • Represent RobCo at partner events, industry meetups, and co-marketing activations

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Global Partner Director and Partner Managers (Munich-based, with US expansion underway) to align marketing activities with partnership priorities and deal flow

  • Collaborate with the broader Marketing team on messaging, content, and campaign integration

  • Feed partner insights back into Marketing and Product to inform positioning and roadmap

  • Proven experience building partner marketing programs, not just running them within an existing structure

  • Strong relationship skills across a diverse partner base - from global tech companies to small traditional German industrial firms

  • Fluent in both German and English - you will work in both languages daily, and some of our most important partners work exclusively in German

  • Experience with co-marketing, joint campaigns, and partner enablement materials

  • A genuine interest in AI and how it applies to your own work - we actively use AI tools to move faster and expect our team to do the same

  • Bonus: familiarity with the industrial automation, robotics, or Physical AI space

data.title: Mid-Market Account Executive - UK&I
data.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. 

This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

This may not be the right role for you if: 

  • You aren't willing to put in the work: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You aren't a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.
  • You have nothing more to learn: Every Samsarian has a growth mindset and believes that what got us here won't get us there.

In this role, you will: 

  • This is a pure hunter role focused on 90% net-new logo acquisition," and "Candidates must have a minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role.Work on strategic account mapping & outbound prospecting
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Work collaboratively with a team of internal / cross-functional stakeholders to remove deal blockers
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • Previous experience in a pure hunter role focused on 80-90% net-new logo acquisition
  • Minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement
  • Experience handling complex mid-large deal cycles
  • Value-based selling approach
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and curious by nature

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

data.title: Senior Content Marketing Manager, Merchant - EMEA
data.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The role

 

Help merchants get more from their partnership with Wolt and Deliveroo.

 

Reporting to the EMEA B2B Content Team Lead, you will own merchant content programmes across both brands, with a particular focus on helping existing merchants improve their operations, discover opportunities and grow their businesses.

 

You will identify the merchant problems worth addressing, develop the content strategy and lead delivery with colleagues across Marketing, Commercial, Operations and Product. You will also write and edit the content yourself, combining strong editorial judgement with clear ownership of performance.

 

Your core portfolio will include merchant editorial content, customer stories, thought leadership and campaigns that support merchant success. This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for setting priorities, leading programmes and demonstrating their impact.

 

What you will own

 

  • Merchant editorial programmes. Build and manage a focused content plan across both brands, including the merchant blog, practical business guidance and thought leadership. Use merchant research, frontline feedback and performance data to decide what deserves investment.

  • Merchant stories and proof. Develop a repeatable case-study programme, from identifying merchants and conducting interviews to securing evidence, approvals and reusable assets.

  • Merchant campaigns. Lead the content strategy and delivery for agreed merchant initiatives, including operational improvements and relevant seasonal occasions. Establish the audience, desired action, content approach, responsibilities and measures before production begins.

  • Content creation and quality. Write and edit compelling content across articles, reports, case studies, email and campaign assets. Brief designers, freelancers and other contributors where needed.

  • Delivery across brands and markets. Coordinate stakeholders, approvals and localisation, adapting content to the needs of each brand and market.

  • Performance and improvement. Set baselines and targets with the relevant teams, monitor results and use them to improve, expand or stop content activity.

 

How you will work

 

You will partner with Growth on website and acquisition content, with GTM on priority launches and with CRM on merchant communications. Those teams own their respective strategies and channel execution; you will own the agreed content programme and its contribution.

 

Within Content, you will collaborate with the owners of merchant education, Ads & Promos, Commerce Platform and social. The Team Lead will continue to lead priority event content during the transition; you may develop stories or campaigns from those events where they support your portfolio.

 

What success looks like

 

You will be accountable for three areas, with targets agreed once baselines and tracking are established:

 

  • Merchant action: the proportion of merchants who take the intended next step after engaging with your content, where tracking allows.

  • Useful engagement: meaningful consumption of priority content, measured through relevant indicators such as engaged reading, completion or repeat engagement.

  • Use of merchant proof: adoption and reuse of case studies and evidence by Commercial and Marketing, with feedback on their effectiveness.

 

You will report what is working, what is not and what you recommend changing. Wider retention and growth outcomes will be shared with the teams responsible for them.

 

What you will bring

 

  • A track record of independently building and improving B2B content programmes, with examples of measurable results.

  • Excellent writing, editing and interviewing skills, supported by a portfolio of substantive work such as case studies, editorial programmes, reports or campaigns.

  • Experience leading campaigns across functions, including setting priorities, resolving competing requests and coordinating delivery.

  • Confidence using analytics and research to make decisions, define success and explain the limits of attribution.

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to turn complex product or operational information into useful merchant content.

  • Experience adapting content across markets, working with specialists and managing external contributors.

  • Experience in marketplaces, merchant services, hospitality, retail or B2B technology would be valuable.

 

Why Join Us?

 

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

 

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 2-3 days in office)

Pricing at Marshmallow

This role will sit in the Pricing Team, reporting into the Pricing Data Science Manager. The team is responsible for managing our loss ratio, underwriting footprint, broker optimisation and growth targets, proving integral to driving the business forwards. But you’ve probably read that all before! So what’s new?

We work in a very different way to most pricing teams that you might be familiar with. Everyone in Pricing has the potential to make significant contribution to the business, taking ownership, moving fast, innovating and delivering changes to our rates at high frequency.

We don’t just churn out GLMs all day. We build & deploy exceptional in-house pricing data science models using the latest modelling techniques. You’ll work alongside other Pricing Data Scientists & Analysts pushing innovative pricing projects, whilst also being able to work with the wider Data Science community on modelling customer behaviour, fraud & MLENG enhancements.

We work alongside a bunch of amazing engineers who ensure we can implement our decisions quickly. We also have access to huge amounts of data. We don’t just mean your standard policy, claims and quote data. Our engineers spend their lives building APIs to third parties so that we know more about our customers than any of our competitors.

All of this means that you’ll have access to as much data as you can handle, the freedom to be creative, the backing of senior leaders to make decisions, and the ability to see your ideas implemented rapidly. And on top of all of that, we’re a pretty fun group to hang around with!

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of Marshmallow’s quote, policy and claims data and use this to derive insights that can be used to enhance our pricing.

  • Own one of the strategic initiatives of the pricing team, such as supporting our expansion plans or protecting our renewing customers.

  • Conducting claims analysis and claims modelling using SQL and Python.

  • Conducting price optimisation analysis/modelling using Python.

  • Building and deploying models in APIs for use in real time pricing.

  • Identify new sources of external data that enable us to refine our view of claims risk, and conduct analysis to quantify their value.

  • Working directly with our Engineering & MLENG functions to implement pricing proposals.

  • Providing pricing support for the launch of multiple new products.

Who are you?

  • Proactive: You drive growth by identifying & delivering new opportunities 

  • Modeller: You use your DS expertise to build innovative best in class models

  • Commercial: You directly use your models as tools to deliver timely real world impact

  • Curious: You aren’t satisfied with ‘That’s just how it is’; you immediately investigate further

  • Owner: You don’t just pull existing levers - you own end to end transformation in your area

  • Opinionated: You generate your own opinions & pitch to others in an open & honest way

  • Explainer: You can communicate complicated concepts in a simple way to non-experts

  • Networker: You build and maintain strong relationships throughout the business

What skills are we looking for from you?

  • Ability to interrogate data and conduct pricing analysis within SQL & Python/R

  • Ability to build GLMs, GBMs and other claims models within Python/R

  • At least 3 years of experience working in a data driven (ideally commercial) role

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

 

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Our process

  • Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)

  • Technical interview with a couple of the team (60 mins)

  • Culture interview (60 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

data.title: Director Care & Clinics Marketing
data.description:
Light is building the financial foundation for businesses operating across entities and currencies, with AI agents doing routine work and people shaping how the system operates. Our ambition is to become the operating layer for entire industries. Care Homes and Clinics are part of our priority verticals.

We’re looking for a Director Care & Clinics Marketing to build our position in these markets as part of a world-class vertical marketing team. You’ll combine deep customer understanding, a clear industry point of view and commercial judgement to turn an opportunity into a repeatable way to win.

You’ll own market understanding, positioning and the marketing pipeline for Care Homes and Clinics, partnering closely with the Care Sales Manager and Clinics Sales Manager and our shared Product Marketing, Demand Generation and Field Marketing teams.

 

What you’ll do

  • Understand the market and choose where to focus. Interview customers and specialist partners to uncover buying triggers, workflows and unmet needs. Build a shared segment plan with Sales, testing opportunities among groups operating multiple care homes, clinics or practices.

  • Define the proposition. Turn customer insight into clear positioning, competitive arguments and a credible industry point of view. Work with Product Marketing to create customer stories, demonstrations and sales kits that show why Light matters to each segment.

  • Own the marketing pipeline. Build the model, set campaign priorities and lead execution with Demand Generation and Field Marketing. Own weekly reporting on qualified opportunities, conversion and progress against pipeline targets, with clear actions when performance falls short.

  • Make AI part of the operating rhythm. Use AI for research, campaign execution and reporting that gets to the why behind the numbers. Investigate what drives conversion and where deals stall, validate the findings with customer and Sales evidence, and turn them into decisions.

  • Be a true partner to Sales. Train direct sales reps and SDRs on the nuances of Care Homes and Clinics: their buyers, language, workflows and objections. Join important customer conversations and equip the team with the insight and proof needed to move deals forward.

  • Build credibility in the sector. Speak at conferences, webinars and industry discussions. Develop relationships with the press, analysts, influencers and specialist partners who shape how buyers think, bringing a useful perspective grounded in customer experience.

  • Bring the customer voice into the product. Partner with Product Marketing to define the workflows, integrations and product requirements critical to these sectors. Work with Product and customer teams to prioritise needs based on evidence and keep market promises grounded in what Light can deliver.

  • Turn early wins into a repeatable approach. Build customer relationships, lead interviews and capture outcomes that become references and case studies. Use win/loss learning to sharpen our targeting, message and campaigns.

 

What you’ll bring

  • Around ten years of marketing experience, with a strong foundation in industry or product marketing and evidence of building markets and delivering commercial results.

  • Experience owning a marketing pipeline from planning through execution and reporting. You can build a model, understand funnel performance and explain what needs to change.

  • An established ability to speak publicly and tell a compelling industry story, whether on stage, in a customer interview or in conversation with the press, analysts and influencers.

  • Experience working with specialist partners and building trusted relationships within Care Homes, Clinics or a closely related sector.

  • A record of partnering closely with Sales, including training direct reps and SDRs to understand a segment and sell into it with credibility.

  • Experience translating customer needs into clear sector requirements with Product Marketing and Product, distinguishing a recurring market need from a one-off request.

  • Strong analytical curiosity and practical experience using AI to investigate performance, test explanations and improve decisions. You verify the output and can explain the reasoning behind your recommendations.

  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, the judgement to challenge assumptions, and a willingness to do the work yourself: interview customers, write the message, build the campaign and examine the results.

  • You’ll bring enough sector understanding to earn credibility quickly, alongside the curiosity to keep learning. We’re looking for someone who can build a market and a repeatable approach, with customer evidence behind both.

 

What success looks like

Clear priorities for Care Homes and Clinics, positioning that resonates with buyers, and a growing marketing pipeline. Weekly reporting explains what is happening, why it is happening and what the team will do next.

Sales reps and SDRs understand the nuances of each segment and have the training, content and customer proof to progress deals. Customers and specialist partners strengthen our presence in the market, while Product Marketing and Product have a clear, evidence-backed view of the requirements that matter most.

You’ll assess progress through qualified pipeline, conversion, sales-cycle performance and customer outcomes, working with Sales and customer teams to understand delivery effort and time to value.

 

How we work

Light’s values are speed, simplicity and transparency. We make decisions when the evidence is sufficient, keep ownership clear and share progress and problems early. We expect leaders to raise the quality of the work, help colleagues succeed and use AI to remove unnecessary effort.

This is an opportunity to shape a priority market from the beginning, with direct influence on how Light understands customers, takes its product to market and develops its offering.

 

The good stuff

🏢 In-office, five days a week, high talent density.
💸 Competitive salary.
🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
🚀 Define what winning looks like in a vertical from the very first deal.
🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, Munich, NY, Paris, and wherever Care Homes & Clinics actually do business.
🥳 Off-sites twice a year. The last one was in Italy.

 

How to apply

Tell us about a specialist market you helped grow: how you built the pipeline, earned credibility with customers and partners, and equipped Sales to win. Share a time your analysis changed the plan, and how customer insight shaped a product requirement.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract) based in United Kingdom.

As an AI Science Writer, you’ll translate cutting-edge AI and machine learning research into accurate, engaging, and accessible stories.
You’ll work at the intersection of scientific research, technical communication, journalism, and multimedia storytelling.
A core part of the role will be reviewing new models, architectures, papers, and research to identify what is genuinely novel and important.
You’ll turn complex technical concepts into compelling written and visual narratives through articles, explainers, diagrams, charts, and other formats.
You’ll engage directly with researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to investigate ideas and verify technical claims.
The role also offers opportunities to cover major conferences, host research-focused events, and experiment with AI-assisted editorial workflows.
This is an ongoing contract position with a fixed monthly retainer, flexibility, and potential opportunities for longer-term career growth.


Accountabilities
  • Produce accurate and engaging scientific and technical reviews covering new AI models, architectures, research papers, internal research, and emerging trends.
  • Analyze technical papers and research findings to identify meaningful innovations, understand methodologies, evaluate limitations, and communicate their significance.
  • Transform complex model architectures and technical concepts into clear visual narratives, including infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements.
  • Develop written content across multiple formats, including analytical reports, long-form features, interviews, technical explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social media content.
  • Interview researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to uncover insights and provide context for stories.
  • Cover major AI research conferences, emerging fields, significant developments, and important discussions across the AI ecosystem.
  • Host or moderate research webinars, interviews, and other on-camera or multimedia formats.
  • Work directly with researchers to fact-check and verify technical claims while maintaining a clear, engaging editorial voice.
  • Collaborate with designers and multimedia producers on more complex visual and interactive stories.
  • Create visual assets independently where appropriate, using AI tools and other relevant technologies to support the production process.
  • Experiment with AI models, agents, coding, and automation to improve research, editorial, analysis, and visual-production workflows.
  • Contribute to an editorial environment focused on making advanced scientific research accessible without oversimplifying its underlying complexity.

    • Requirements:

    • Professional or academic experience in AI/ML research, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
    • A degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, physics, engineering, computational science, or another relevant technical field.
    • Strong ability to read and interpret scientific papers, inspect model architectures, compare experimental results, and discuss technical details directly with researchers.
    • Strong technical writing and editorial skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts accurately, clearly, and engagingly.
    • Strong visual communication instincts and the ability to explain technical mechanisms through diagrams, infographics, charts, and other multimedia formats.
    • Ability to assess the significance and limitations of research rather than simply summarize findings.
    • Excellent interviewing and communication skills, with confidence engaging researchers, engineers, and technical experts.

data.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).

Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.

This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.

You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.

As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence. You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't. Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.

The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.

Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.

Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.

Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.

Become the developer community's champion by writing technical content at a regular cadence that Solutions Engineering uses in live deals, and answering architecture and integration questions directly rather than routing them to Product.

Build hx's position in actuarial AI by developing differentiated positioning and up-to-date competitive understanding that works consistently across website copy, enablement, and customer conversations.

Establish strong feedback loops between users, Product, Revenue, and the AI team, so insight from launches, testing, and field conversations directly informs messaging, prioritisation, and product direction.

What you'll need to have done

Led product marketing in a B2B SaaS environment, balancing adoption work for an existing product with launch readiness for a new one at the same time - demonstrating commercial judgement across multiple GTM motions.

Increased engagement or adoption of a mature product by using user insight to sharpen messaging or enablement - with measurable improvement in usage, understanding, or qualitative feedback from users and revenue teams.

Owned a product launch end to end, including the internal readiness and enablement work that happens before it ships - not just the moment it goes out.

Turned a complex technical capability into credible, differentiated messaging for a skeptical, technical audience - developers or an equivalent evaluator population - built on real user insight rather than generic claims.

Worked hands-on alongside a Solutions Engineer or equivalent technical partner, comfortable being challenged on technical detail and holding your line, and earning trust across Product, Engineering, and Revenue without relying on formal authority.

Used AI with real judgement about when a technical claim is actually true rather than just plausible, and applied that judgement to rebuild how systems like enablement, competitive intelligence, or win/loss work - not just run them faster.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.

  • You focus primarily on flashy launch work or brand campaigns rather than the detail-oriented, outcomes-driven work of deepening adoption, engagement, and user understanding.

  • You struggle to prioritise or make trade-offs without perfect information, waiting for others to decide rather than using judgment to move work forward with the context available.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Talent Screening (30 minutes)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)

  3. Skills Assessment & Panel (45 minutes)

  4. Values Interview (60 minutes)

  5. Meet the CEO/CPO/VP Eng (40 minutes)

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

About Us

Nylon is rebuilding how professional advice gets made. Not built for accountants and lawyers — built with them.

We work alongside firms that cannot afford to be wrong. They expect precision, speed and an answer they can put their name to, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our platform turns tax and accounting research that used to take hours into minutes, and powers the end-to-end workflow around it.

We are firmly established in the UK, working with tax and accounting firms across the country, with clients across professional services in Australia and New Zealand and partnerships with the professional bodies our prospects already belong to. We are now opening the United States.

Joining Nylon means three things.

  • We move first: high agency over waiting for permission, outcomes over intentions.

  • We hold the bar: direct, ego-free feedback and standards that do not slip when it is busy.

  • We learn out loud: what you work out on the phone today, the whole team uses tomorrow.

Small team. Real ownership. No passengers.

If you are driven by pace, mastery, and being early to something that is about to get very big — this is the place.

What You'll Do

  • Own the phone. Cold call decision-makers at professional services firms and book qualified meetings for our sales team.

  • Open a new market. Work a UK-led patch that now includes early-stage outreach into the US — all inside a normal Brighton working day.

  • Run a tight rhythm. Call blocks, follow-ups and clean pipeline hygiene, executed the same way every day.

  • Learn the product properly. Our products are new and genuinely complex; knowing how firms actually get value from them is the job, not a nice-to-have.

  • Sharpen the message. Learn our ICP and messaging fast, then make both better through iteration and feedback.

  • Research like an analyst. Use trusted sources to understand prospects, personalise outreach and lift conversion.

  • Feed the machine. Share what you hear on calls so we can tighten targeting and positioning.

What You Bring

  • Extreme motivation to master selling. You want to be the best in the world at this, and you are prepared for what that takes.

  • High agency. You find the way through rather than waiting to be told.

  • A strong verbal game. Clear, concise, human — and comfortable being the first voice a partner hears that week.

  • Resilience. No does not slow you down.

  • Pace. We move fast, so you learn and adapt fast.

  • Coachability. You take direct feedback and apply it the same day.

Your academic background is not essential. What you can demonstrate is.

What's In It For You

  • Warm ground to work from. An established UK client base and professional body partnerships that put our name in front of your prospects before you call them.

  • A market to open, not just a patch to work. You will help build something from nothing rather than maintaining what is already there.

  • Front-row seat to the AI shift in professional services. You will be selling the change, not reading about it.

  • World-class training. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching on our own AI systems and modern B2B SaaS sales methods.

  • Commission earned on qualified meetings attended.

  • Peer recognition scheme and corporate discounts.

  • An in-person environment. A Brighton office built for people who want to be in the room.

Nylon is an equal opportunity employer

data.title: Marketing Lead
data.description:
Own marketing at an AI legal research company that already has 1,900+ firms as customers.

Nylon is an AI-native tax and legal research platform used by 1,900+ accountancy and law firms across the UK, Australia and New Zealand. We were the first product accredited by ICAEW in the Legal Information and Research Software category, and we hold an ACCA affiliation. The UK business has been built almost entirely on outbound sales. It works, and it has taken us a long way. Now we want a second engine, and you would be the person who builds it.

This is our first dedicated marketing hire in the UK. There is no team beneath you yet and no playbook to inherit. There is a working sales motion, a product accountants and lawyers actually use, strong accreditation credentials, and a founder-led company that moves quickly. You will set the marketing strategy and then do most of the work yourself.

What you'll own

  • Pipeline. SEO and content, paid search and LinkedIn, email nurture, webinars and free-trial campaigns. Your number is qualified pipeline handed to our SDR and AE team, and you will be measured on it.

  • Brand and content. Sharpen how Nylon shows up in the UK accountancy and legal market: website, thought leadership, case studies, PR and awards, and the marketing side of our ICAEW and ACCA relationships.

  • Product marketing. Own the messaging. Turn what the product does into language that lands with a tax partner or a managing partner, keep our positioning against incumbent research providers sharp, and equip the sales team with battlecards, decks and one-pagers.

  • Events and community. Get us in front of the right people: ICAEW and ACCA events, industry conferences, our own roundtables and customer community. Some travel within the UK.

  • Measurement. Set up attribution and reporting in our CRM (Attio) so we know what is working, and kill what is not.

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in B2B marketing, with at least a few of those in SaaS or a subscription product, ideally selling to professional services (accountancy, legal, financial services).

  • You have built something from little or nothing before: a demand-gen function, a content programme, a launch. You are comfortable being the strategist and the person executing at 4pm on a Thursday.

  • Fluent in the tools: SEO and analytics, paid search and paid social, marketing automation and CRM, and the AI tools that make a small team punch above its weight.

  • You write well. Clearly, quickly, without fluff. Most of what marketing produces is words, and ours need to be credible to accountants and lawyers.

  • Commercially minded. You care about pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics, and you enjoy working shoulder to shoulder with a sales team.

  • Curious about AI and about how professional services firms are changing. You do not need a legal or tax background, but you need to be able to learn the market fast.

Nice to have: experience marketing to accountants or lawyers; familiarity with ICAEW, ACCA or Law Society ecosystems; hands-on experience with webinar programmes or partnership marketing.

What we offer

  • £55,000–£70,000 base, depending on experience

  • Real ownership: you set the strategy, you get the budget, you build the team as we grow

  • A product customers rely on daily and a market that is being reshaped by AI right now

  • A small, fast, international team across the UK, Australia and New Zealand

Please send a CV and, instead of a cover letter, one page on how you would generate qualified pipeline for Nylon in your first 90 days.

Nylon is the trading name of Law Cyborg Limited. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from everyone. You must have the right to work in the UK.

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you sell to the engineering leaders who cannot afford to get incidents wrong, and every deal you close is one more company that handles its worst day better.

That gap is the whole opportunity.

The team you're joining are seasoned sellers who are as much strategic partners and product evangelists as they are closers. Enterprise cycles here mean six or seven decision-makers, technical buyers who will test you properly, and C-level conversations where you need to be credible immediately. We are growing our team and looking for passionate builders to join us and support our expanding customer base.

As our first EMEA Channel Sales Manager, you'll own building Artemis's indirect go-to-market motion in the UK and Europe. You'll identify, recruit, and enable strategic partners (Distributors Value Added Resellers, MSSP’s and GSI’s) to sell Artemis into new and existing customer base. You'll develop partner programs, provide enablement and support, manage partner relationships, and ensure partners are generating pipeline and closing deals.

This role is critical to scaling beyond direct sales. You'll have autonomy to shape our channel strategy, build partner relationships from scratch, and drive significant revenue through indirect channels.

  • Identify and recruit strategic channel partners (Distributors, Value Added Resellers, MSSP’s and GSI’s) across the UK and Europe

  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to monitor pipeline, revenue, and performance

  • Support partner sales teams on complex deals (technical questions, customer introductions, deal strategy)

  • Co-market with partners (joint webinars, events, case studies, campaigns)

The role

This is a full-time Collections Administrator role with hybrid working (minimum 3 days per week in the Milton Keynes office).

The role will be responsible for managing delinquent accounts as they flow through the collections strategy. Day-to-day tasks include administration and reconciliation tasks, updating case management systems, reviewing and processing both hard copy and digital correspondence and liaising with third parties.
